statements.quoted: Dean Ayanna Howard of @OSUengineering was in DC this week to testify before the Joint Economic Committee hearing on #AI’s potential to fuel economic growth. Stopped by the office afterwards for a great discussion with @RepMaxMiller! https://t.co/JFX5ZSLhCo

statements.text:
Today, I was joined by @GovMikeDeWine and @SenJonHusted to meet with STEM students at the @GLScienceCtr.

We need sharp, creative minds to lead in AI, robotics, and space technology. These Students are certainly up for the task.

Thank you, @kellenbogen, for having us! https://t.co/v7l0uAQ33j

I am in full support of Ohio's HB 983 as it requires large new or expanded Ohio data centers to obtain local voter approval, operate with closed-loop water systems and stringent environmental controls, pay for any water or environmental impacts they cause, generate their own electricity off-grid without imposing costs on Ohio ratepayers, disclose development agreements and chemical use, and forgo local tax incentives. Ohioans deserve a say in their future. These common sense measures should be considered by the federal government.
statements.venue: Post on X by Rep. Max Miller, quoted in The Ohio Independent
